attributes.description: Client id of the web app registration (ID tokens are issued to it).
Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API directly. Empty: same-origin only.
First admin (and platform administrator), created at first start-up if missing.
Optional custom domain for the API and web app, e.g. review.example.com (CNAME to the API app, plus the asuid TXT record).
Optional customer-owned model endpoint.
Optional: discovered from the issuer when empty.
Public URL of the API (and the bundled web app), e.g. https://review.example.com. Empty: https://<custom_domain> when set, else the API's default Container Apps address.
Where people open the web app, if different from public_base_url (SSO redirects, email links).
Basic (single node, no SLA), Standard (replicated, default) or Premium (adds data persistence; needs redis_capacity >= 1).
Allow email and password sign-in alongside SSO.
Bearer token clients must send to the hosted MCP server. Empty: one is generated (output mcp_http_token).
Bearer token required to scrape /metrics. Empty: one is generated (output metrics_token); production start-up requires one.
Client secret of the web app registration (optional: the browser flow uses PKCE).
Initial password for the first admin. Change it after signing in, then clear this variable.
PFX certificate for custom_domain, base64-encoded. Empty: bind an Azure managed certificate after the first apply.
Source app API key for a hosted MCP server in submitter mode. Empty: no MCP container app.
ClamAV image, run as a sidecar next to the API so every upload is scanned.
Azure region. UK South keeps data in the UK; use westeurope or northeurope for EU residency.
Expose the hosted MCP server on the internet. Default false: reachable only inside the Container Apps environment.
Keep the 0.0.0.0 firewall rule (any Azure service may reach the server's login). Needed while the Container Apps environment has no virtual network; set false once it does.
Extra firewall rules, e.g. { office = { start = "203.0.113.10", end = "203.0.113.10" } }.
Container image for infra/libreoffice.
Container image for the API, worker and MCP server (built from the repo Dockerfile).
Internal to the Container Apps environment unless mcp_external_ingress is true.
Value of the asuid.<custom_domain> TXT record.
